featured_reviews.name: Kundan Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Last evening, we visited BBC Restaurant (AC Room) with family for dinner.
The food was truly delicious, especially the vegetarian dishes — rich in taste and well presented.
The service, however, was a bit slow; we had to wait around 20 minutes for each dishes we ordered, which slightly tested our patience.
That said, the atmosphere made up for it — warm, calm, and pleasant. Every table seemed lost in its own little world, enjoying the moment.
Overall, a satisfying family dining experience with great food and a relaxed vibe.

Must Try:
Paneer Tikka Biryani
Chocolate Chips Icecream
Mashroom Starters

featured_reviews.name: prasad acharekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
A very bad and Pathetic experience at BBC dahisar...
I had taken a take away order for their Signature fish Afghani Chicken.
The food was terrible and the chicken wasn't cooked.. The undercooked food was not fit for consumption.. Moreover when I tried complaining about this the staff disregarded my order stating it was delivered and since the packet was opened they won't be doing anything else, leading to a very Derrogatory and dissatisfactory experience.
Such kind of service from an outlet of BBC is competely unheard of.
Totally disappointing.

featured_reviews.name: ankita nemlekar
featured_reviews.review_text:

Also previous day Kumbh Lazeez was ordered for spicy as instructed but was delivered sweet one

featured_reviews.name: Iqbal Tamboli
featured_reviews.review_text: Food quality is ok but overhyped for Biryani in my opinion. We had Matka Dum Biryani but did not feel like it is Dum Biryani at all. My stomach got upset after having their Paya soup. Service is the worst Part on top of it. Nobody cares. So overall not a pleasant experience.

featured_reviews.name: M m
featured_reviews.review_text: This is really big..ground plus two floors. Always buzzing with customers. The food is amazing..I tried the mutton tava pulao and it was amazingggggg. I tried it again and again .. hehe. Their kebabs are awesome. I love the chicken dum biryani. It's worth ordering online as well as dining in.

featured_reviews.name: vikrant jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
Order Mutton Rogan Josh and Mutton dum biryani .
Gravy taste was very good. Enjoyed eating  rotis with it. One big negative is the mutton pieces were not fully cooked. The pieces on its own were not from a young goat hence the hard texture of mutton pieces. May be overcooking would help.
Same feedback for biryani,  the spices and quantity was good , however,  the pieces were not tender, soft, juicy and were not fully cooked.
I have had laal maas in udaipur in many famous restaurants there. BBC team should borrow their meat selection logic from udaipur.

featured_reviews.name: Atul Nimbalkar
featured_reviews.review_text: The ambience is good. Food is okay taste wise. Service is very prompt and professional. However, I found the food served to us was not fresh hence three stars. They also serve alcohol. A good place to visit along with family, friends or colleagues.

featured_reviews.name: Gagan Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
This restaurant is situated Nearby Link Road in between Aanand Nagar and Dahisar Metro Station. Earlier this restaurant was known by name Veg Klub. Restaurant has very good ambiance and lots of seating options to choose from.

This restaurant is famous for Tandoor and Mainly for Biryani. We ordered Tandoori, Paneer Makhmali, Masala papad, Chicken Dum Biryani and drinks too.

Food was tasty and delicious. Chicken pieces were mouth melting, soft and properly cooked. Staff is very very friendly and cooperative. Service is quick.

featured_reviews.name: Vinu Vijayan
featured_reviews.review_text:
**New Discovery Alert**

We came across this muti-cuisine restaurant in the heart of Dahisar serving some good food & a chill place to drink & hangout with buddies over some rightly placed food and booze.

Lotus Court is a Seafood specialty restaurant offering some delicious dishes for one to try.

Here is a small brief on what we had  :

The tandoori appetizers were well prepared and well presented

Chicken Dum Kebab (Right texture & flavors)
Paneer Dum Kebab (Well marinated & soft)

From the Seafood section we had the below :

Prawns Tawa Garlic (Perfect Muncher)
Lotus Squids (Loved it)
Surmai Tawa Fry (Delicious)
Stuffed Bombil  (Delicacy)
Bombil Tawa Fry (All-time favorite)
Tisriya Masala Dry (Delicacy)
Mix Veg Lotus

From the Vegetarian section we had the below :

Cheese Balls
Lotus Special Subzi
Burnt Garlic Fried Rice
Amboli / Bakhri / Neer Dosa

The place is tastefully done with many themed sections for one to sit and dine at.

Mr. Clifford who manages the place is a delight to talk to and guides you for the best of food & drinks.

The Food: Absolute "Maa ke haath ka swad." The Dal Bati Churma is the standout—authentic, rich, and deeply satisfying.

A must-visit in Dahisar for anyone who appreciates great food and beautiful ambience.

featured_reviews.name: Chef Vaidehi Pathare
featured_reviews.review_text:
Celebration's By The Veg Treat is about a 10-minute walk from the Dahisar Railway Station. I have visited twice and had a decent experience on both occasions. The place gets busy in the evenings, so it is better to visit in the afternoon or early evening. When I went with my family at 9:30 pm, we had to wait for 20 minutes to get a table.

The restaurant has both indoor air-conditioned seating and outdoor seating. We chose outdoor seating as air-conditioned seating area was fully occupied. But the tables on the left side did not seem suitable for four people, they were comfortable for only two people.

During my visits, I tried Pav Bhaji, Watermelon Juice, Filter Coffee, Triple Schezwan Fried Rice, Masala Dosa, Veg Mille-Jullie, Roti, Jeera Rice, and Sizzling Brownie. The Filter Coffee was good. The Pav Bhaji was made less spicy for a younger diner and was prepared just right. The Triple Schezwan Fried Rice was very good with a lot of vegetables. Masala Dosa was tasty and filling for one person. Veg Mille-Jullie had a spicy and tangy taste that made it different. The Sizzling Brownie was nice, although the brownie was slightly undercooked. The Watermelon Juice was fresh and the Jeera Rice was good.

The food quality is good, the portions are reasonable, but the prices are slightly high. The service is slow and we had to ask more than once for basic things like spoons or water.

Ratings:
Quality - 4/5
Quantity - 3.5/5
Service - 2.5/5
Price - ₹600 for 2 people

For more mouthwatering food content, don’t forget to follow @chefvaidehipathare on Instagram!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Finally visited Nityanand Pav Bhaji and the taste truly lived up to the hype 😍🔥
The pav bhaji was super buttery, rich in flavor and perfectly balanced with spices. Pav was soft, fresh and nicely toasted in butter 🧈 The tawa pulao and dosa options are also worth trying.

featured_reviews.name: Kapil Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
It was a lazy Sunday and I had to order lunch and I randomly picked this on Zomato delivery...

It serves North Indian, mughlai, veg and non veg food...

I ordered below items...

Tandoori chicken - taste wise it was ok however it was burnt from few sides...

Paneer tikka masala - Its gravy was delicious however paneer pieces were little hard and too much oil was there...

Roti - Tandoori Roti was as usual good...

Salad - complementary salad of cabbage, capsicum, it was little tangy...it tastes good...some onion and lemon pieces were there too...

Mint or pudina chutney - this was the best thing in whole meal...yummy chutney...it was complementary too...

It is a pocket friendly restaurant however they need to work on their quality...

Overall it was just ok...

Zomato delivery 4/5
Food 3/5
Value for money 3/5

Thanks for the reading, please like if it helps.
